nodes.name: Apify Config
nodes.notes: Configuration for Apify scraping. Set test_mode=false for production runs. Get Apify token from: https://console.apify.com/account/integrations

nodes.name: LinkedIn - Start Actor
nodes.notes: Starts Apify LinkedIn scraper actor. Cost: ~$3-5 per 1,000 profiles.

nodes.name: Wait for LinkedIn
nodes.notes: Wait 45 seconds for LinkedIn actor to complete scraping

nodes.name: LinkedIn - Fetch Results
nodes.notes: Fetches LinkedIn lead data from Apify dataset

nodes.name: LinkedIn - Error Check
nodes.notes: Checks if LinkedIn scraping was successful. Continues workflow even if failed.

nodes.name: Facebook - Start Actor
nodes.notes: Starts Apify Facebook pages scraper actor. Cost: ~$4-5 per 1,000 pages.

nodes.name: Wait for Facebook
nodes.notes: Wait 60 seconds for Facebook actor to complete (slower than LinkedIn)

nodes.name: Facebook - Fetch Results
nodes.notes: Fetches Facebook page data from Apify dataset

nodes.name: Facebook - Error Check
nodes.notes: Checks if Facebook scraping was successful. Continues workflow even if failed.

nodes.name: Google Maps - Start Actor
nodes.notes: Starts Apify Google Maps scraper actor. Cost: ~$2-3 per 1,000 businesses.

nodes.name: Wait for Google Maps
nodes.notes: Wait 30 seconds for Google Maps actor to complete (fastest scraper)

nodes.name: Google Maps - Fetch Results
nodes.notes: Fetches Google Maps business data from Apify dataset

nodes.name: Google Maps - Error Check
nodes.notes: Checks if Google Maps scraping was successful. Continues workflow even if failed.

nodes.name: Merge All Platforms
nodes.notes: Combines successful results from all 3 platforms

nodes.name: Transform Apify Data
nodes.notes: Maps Apify-specific fields to standardized schema with 25+ enhanced fields

nodes.name: Deduplicate Leads
nodes.notes: Removes duplicates by email, LinkedIn URL, or company+name

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Appends enriched leads to 'Raw Leads - Apify' tab in Google Sheets
